p: land shadowing with wings: He means that part of Ethiopia which lies toward the sea, which was so full of ships that the sails (which he compares to wings) seemed to shadow the sea.
bulrushes upon the waters: Which is those countries were great, so much so that they made ships from them for swiftness.

Go: This may be taken that they sent others to comfort the Jews and to promise them help against their enemies, and so the Lord threatened to take away their strength, that the Jews should not trust in it: or that they solicited the Egyptians and promised them aid to go against Judah.
people terrible from their beginning to: That is, the Jews who because of God's plague made all other nations afraid of the same, as God threatened in De 28:37.
rivers have laid waste: Meaning the Assyrians, Isa 8:7.
he lifteth up an ensign on: When the Lord prepared to fight against the Ethiopians.
rest: I will stay a while from punishing the wicked.

clear heat upon herbs: Which two seasons are profitable for the ripening of fruit, by which he means that he will seem to favour them and give them abundance for a time, but he will suddenly cut them off.
beasts of the earth: Not only men will contemn them, but the brute beast.
present be brought to the LORD: Meaning that God will pity his Church, and receive that little remnant as an offering to himself.
